scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Hello stranger.
I wish I could
offer you help
on your adventures...
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
你好，陌生人。
真希望能在你的冒险中帮上忙...

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
We can't even begin
to fathom the number
of markets and people
out there in this wide,
wide world of ours.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
在这个广阔的世界里，有多少市场、多少人，我们根本无法想象。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
I believe it's time
for my final lecture.
I'll discuss the definitive
skill of the Merchant: ^871F78Vending^000000. Please listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
我想是时候进行最后一课了。
我将讲解商人的终极技能：^871F78露天商店^000000。
请仔细听好。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So...
How much have
you learned
about Vending?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
那么...
你关于露天商店学到了多少？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Now to talk about
^871F78Push Cart^000000. First off, you need to know Level 5 Increase Weight Limit before you can even learn the Push Cart skill.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
接下来谈谈^871F78手推车^000000。
首先，你需要先学会5级负重量上升，才能学习手推车技能。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So, have you
learned Push Cart up
to Level 4 like I asked?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
那么，你按照我的要求把手推车练到4级了吗？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, ready to
learn already,
are you? Alright,
let me tell you
about ^871F78Over Charge^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
啊，已经准备好要学了吗？
好的，让我告诉你关于^871F78高价卖出^000000的事。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So...
How is it going
with learning that
^871F78Over Charge^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
那么...
学习^871F78高价卖出^000000技能进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Let me see those
Red Potions. Now,
how much did you
pay for these...?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
让我看看那些红色药水。
那么，你花多少钱买到的这些...？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Let me see those
Red Potions. Ah, it seems you researched the market and bought the cheapest ones! Great work!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
让我看看那些红色药水。啊，看来你研究了市场行情，买了最便宜的！
干得漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Hmm...
You'll find some NPCs
selling 10 Red Potions
in Prontera. Your task
is to buy the potions
for the cheapest price.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
嗯...
你会在普隆德拉找到一些NPC出售10瓶红色药水。
你的任务是以最低的价格买到药水。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright...
I've given it some thought and I've come up with a little challenge for you. Bring me... 10 Red Potions!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
好的...
我思考了一下，为你准备了一个小挑战。
给我带来...10瓶红色药水！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, you're back!
Now, I was going
to tell you about
the Discount skill, right?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
啊，你回来了！
我本来想告诉你关于低价买进技能，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So, how is it going with learning the Discount skill? Like I always say, if you can't make a bargain, you can't be a Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
那么，学习低价买进技能进展如何？
就像我常说的，如果你不会砍价，你就不能成为商人！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, you've come back to learn more. Let's see, what was I going to tell you about... Right, Mammonite!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
啊，你回来学更多了。
让我想想，我本来想告诉你什么...对了，金钱攻击！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So...
Did you learn the
Increase Weight Limit
skill up to Level 4
like I asked?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
那么...
你按照我的要求把负重量上升练到4级了吗？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
You've just started out as a Merchant, haven't you? How would you like to learn the fundamentals of business from an experienced colleague?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
你刚开始做商人，对吧？
你想不想向一位经验丰富的同事学习商业基础？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
However, what I have to teach would only benefit Merchants. Trading and money making are my areas of expertise. If you have any Merchant friends, send them to me.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
不过，我要教的内容只对商人有好处。
交易和赚钱是我的专长。
如果你有商人朋友，把他们介绍给我吧。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Technically, yes, you're a Merchant, but I know an expert when I see one. You've been through the Merchant life before, I can tell!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
从技术上讲，是的，你是商人，但我一眼就能看出行家。
你以前经历过商人的生活，我能看出来！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
All of them are possible customers and business partners. Of course, it'll be up to you to meet them.
If you can be sincerely kind to everyone that you meet, you'll
have no problem.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
他们所有人都是潜在的顾客和商业伙伴。
当然，去结识他们取决于你。
如果你能真诚地善待你遇到的每个人，你就不会有问题。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
The Vending skill is an active skill which allows you to open your own shop where you stand. Vending allows you to do real business with other people.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
露天商店是一个主动技能，允许你在站立的位置开设自己的店铺。通过露天商店，你可以与其他玩家进行真实的交易。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
However, you can only vend items that are stored in your PushCart,
so you'll need one of those. The maximum price you can set for
each item is 99,990,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
不过，你只能出售存放在手推车里的物品，所以你需要一辆手推车。每件物品的最高定价为99,990,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Basically, you've got to learn the Push Cart skill first before you can learn the Vending skill.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
基本上，你必须先学会手推车技能，才能学会露天商店技能。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
The higher the level of the Vending skill, the more items you can vend at one time. Vending is mastered at Skill Level 10.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
露天商店技能等级越高，一次能出售的物品数量就越多。该技能在10级时达到精通。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Level 1 Vending allows you
to vend a total of 3 items at one time. Each time you level up the Vending skill, the total number of items you can vend will
increase by one.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
1级露天商店允许你一次出售3件物品。每提升一级露天商店技能，可出售的物品总数就会增加1件。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
But it looks like I just put my foot in my mouth. I'm sorry, I didn't notice that you already mastered the Vending skill...
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
哎呀，看来我多嘴了。抱歉，我没注意到你已经精通露天商店技能了...

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
For your final assignment, I will ask you to learn the Vending skill up to Skill Level 4. Of course, once you do, I'll give you a little reward. I'll be waiting, so do your best~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
作为最后的任务，我会要求你将露天商店技能练到4级。当然，完成后我会给你一点奖励。我会等着你的，加油哦~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
But I see that you must already know that, huh? Well, seeing as you're so clever, I think you've earned this little prize~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
不过我看你似乎已经知道了，对吧？既然你这么聪明，我想你值得这份小礼物~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
You're such an
excellent student!
Please, take this
little reward for
all your efforts~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
你真是个好学生！
请收下这份小奖励，以表彰你的努力~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Hmm...
Haven't learned Level 4 Vending yet, huh? Just keep in mind that being able to vend things is one
of the defining characteristics of being a Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
嗯...
还没学会4级露天商店，是吗？
请记住，能够出售物品是商人这一职业的重要特征之一！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Excellent!
You've taught yourself well. Here, you've earned this little reward~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
太棒了！
你自学得很好。给你，这是你应得的小奖励~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Oh, I see that you're very serious about being a Merchant. I'm proud that you've managed to master this skill! Here, you deserve this reward!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
哦，看来你对成为商人非常认真。我很自豪你能掌握这项技能！给你，你值得这份奖励！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, now you have mastered the fundamentals of the Merchant class. Just keep practicing the basic principles, like researching the market for item prices, and you should be fine.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
啊，现在你已经掌握了商人职业的基础。只要继续练习基本原则，比如研究市场价格，你就没问题了。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Although everything we do is for money, never forget customer needs and always sell your products at a suitably fair price. Otherwise, no one may buy your goods!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
虽然我们所做的一切都是为了钱，但永远不要忘记顾客的需求，并以合理的价格出售商品。否则，可能没人会买你的东西！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Well, there's nothing more I can teach you for now. Go out into the world and make your mark as a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
好了，目前我没什么更多可以教你的了。去外面的世界闯荡吧，在商人的道路上留下你的印记。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
And feel free to
visit me whenever
the mood strikes you.
Good luck to you~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
如果你想我了，随时欢迎来找我。
祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Push Cart can be mastered at
Skill Level 10. This skill allows you to carry a Push Cart with you. You can carry a maximum of 100 different kinds of items that weigh less than 8,000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
手推车技能在10级时达到精通。该技能允许你携带手推车。你可以携带最多100种重量小于8,000的不同物品。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
As you can see, this skill is an advanced form of the Increase Weight Limit skill. You can procure a PushCart from most Kafra Ladies for a certain fee.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
如你所见，这项技能是负重量上升技能的进阶形式。你可以向大多数卡普拉 职员支付一定费用来租用手推车。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Once you have rented a Cart, you can hold on to it so long as you don't take it off. The disadvantage to using a PushCart is that your movement speed is reduced to
almost half! Horrible, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
一旦租用了手推车，只要你不卸下它，就可以一直持有。使用手推车的不便之处在于，你的移动速度会降低到几乎一半！很糟糕，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Fortunately, when you increase
the level of the Push Cart skill, your movement speed will slowly be restored. With Push Cart Level 10, a PushCart won't slow you
down at all!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
幸运的是，当你提升手推车技能等级时，你的移动速度会逐渐恢复。在手推车技能达到10级时，手推车完全不会拖慢你的速度！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
For now, why don't
you learn the Push Cart
skill up to Level 4? Once
you do that, I can go on to
my next lecture.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
那么，先试着把“手推车”技能练到4级吧？
等你练好了，我就可以继续讲下一课了。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, and I see that you've been focusing on learning Push Cart. Although you might still have a problem with your movement
speed, it shouldn't be a big deal.
Well done~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
啊，看来你一直在专心练习“手推车”技能。
虽然你的移动速度可能还是有点慢，但这不是什么大问题。
做得很好~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Wonderful! You've already
mastered the Push Cart skill.
You truly deserve a little bit of a reward~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
太棒了！你已经掌握了“手推车”技能。
你确实值得获得一点小奖励~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Still not there, huh?
Well, remember that you need
Level 5 Increase Weight Limit before you can learn the Push
Cart skill. I hope that helps.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
还没练好吗？
记住，你需要先将“负重量上升”技能练到5级，才能学习“手推车”技能。
希望这能帮到你。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Well done~
You've been a very
cooperative student.
You deserve a little
reward for your effort~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
做得很好~
你是一个非常配合的学生。
为了你的努力，你值得获得一点小奖励~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Excellent!
You've actually went above and beyond mastered the Push Cart skill. Great work!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
太出色了！
你不仅掌握了“手推车”技能，还超额完成了任务。干得漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Next time, I'll talk about the skill that sets Merchants apart from all the other classes: ^871F78Vending^000000. So don't miss it!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
下次，我会讲解让商人与其他职业区分开来的技能：^871F78露天商店^000000。千万不要错过哦！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Like Discount, Over Charge is a Passive skill that can be mastered at Skill Level 10. Therefore, it doesn't require SP to use it.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
和“低价买进”一样，“高价卖出”是一项被动技能，在技能等级10时达到精通。因此，使用它不需要消耗SP。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Over Charge allows you to sell items to NPC shops for more Zeny. The higher your Over Charge Skill Level, the more Zeny you'll receive for items sold to NPCs.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
“高价卖出”可以让你以更高的Zeny价格将物品卖给NPC商店。你的“高价卖出”技能等级越高，卖给NPC的物品获得的Zeny就越多。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Personally, I think you should learn this skill for sure! For your next assignment, learn Over Charge up to Level 4. It shouldn't be too difficult to do.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
我个人认为你一定要学习这项技能！你的下一个任务是：将“高价卖出”练到4级。这应该不会太难。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, you've already learned Level 4 Over Charge. Perfect! Let me give you a little reward~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
啊，你已经练到4级“高价卖出”了。完美！让我给你一点小奖励~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Amazing! You've already mastered the Over Charge skill! You must have wanted this reward badly~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
太厉害了！你已经掌握了“高价卖出”技能！你一定很想要这个奖励吧~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Once you do that,
we can talk about
more advanced stuff.
Do your best~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
等你完成这个任务，我们就可以讨论更高级的内容了。
加油~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Mm? You haven't
learned Over Charge
up to Skill Level 4 yet?
There's no rush, but I won't be able to lecture on anything until you finish this little task.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
嗯？你还没把“高价卖出”练到4级吗？
不用着急，但在你完成这个小任务之前，我无法继续讲课。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Nice work!
I can tell that
you've done just
as I asked. Please,
take this little reward~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
干得好！
可以看出你完全按照我的要求做了。请收下这点小奖励~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Whoa...
You actually
mastered Over Charge?
Most impressive! You deserve a small reward for your work!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
哇...
你真的掌握了“高价卖出”？
太令人印象深刻了！为了你的努力，你值得获得一点小奖励！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Next time, I'll discuss the
Push Cart skill. Be ready for this lecture, as Push Cart is one of the more important skills for a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
下次，我会讲解“手推车”技能。请为这堂课做好准备，因为“手推车”是商人最重要的技能之一。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah...!
It looks like...
You were scammed!
D-don't worry, though,
I won't tell anybody.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
啊...！
看起来...你被骗了！
别担心，我不会告诉任何人的。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Oh well, it happens even to the best of us. Just think of this as an invaluable learning experience.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
算了，这种事连最厉害的人也会遇到。就把这次经历当作一次宝贵的学习经验吧。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Now, why don't you go to Prontera and try to buy 10 Red Potions from an NPC for the cheapest price again?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
现在，去普隆德拉试试，以最低的价格从NPC那里买10瓶红色药水吧？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright, next time, we'll talk about the skill that you can learn after knowing how to Discount:
^871F78Over Charge^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
好的，下次，我们来谈谈在学会“低价买进”之后可以学习的技能：
^871F78高价卖出^000000。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
First, you'll probably want to research the market price for Red Potions. And always, be careful of scammers and cheats!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
首先，你最好研究一下红色药水的市场价格。而且，一定要小心骗子和作弊者！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
It's not too hard, but the stipulation I'm adding is that you've got to find the merchant selling Red Potions for the cheapest price.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
这并不难，但我加了一个条件：你必须找到以最低价格出售红色药水的商人。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So first, you'll need to research the market price for Red Potions. Also, be careful of scammers! If the price is too good to be true, it usually is.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
所以首先，你需要研究红色药水的市场价格。另外，小心骗子！如果价格好得难以置信，那多半就是假的。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ha ha ha, let me make your goal a bit less confusing. You will need to buy 10 Red Potions from an NPC in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
哈哈，让我把你的目标说得更清楚一点。你需要在普隆德拉从NPC那里购买10瓶红色药水。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Prontera's a bit far from here, isn't it? I'll just use this Kafra Warp-- Mahnsoo has a bunch for
some reason --to send you there right now. Get ready...!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
普隆德拉离这里有点远，不是吗？我就用这个卡普拉传送——Mahnsoo不知为何有一堆——现在就把你送过去。准备好...！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
The ^871F78Discount^000000 skill allows you to buy items at lower prices from NPC shops. It is a ^871F78Passive Skill^000000 which is always in effect and does not consume SP.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
^871F78低价买进^000000技能可以让你以更低的价格从NPC商店购买物品。这是一个^871F78被动技能^000000，始终生效且不消耗SP。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
The Discount skill is
mastered at ^871F78Level 10^000000. The higher the skill level, the less you have to pay for items at NPC shops.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
“低价买进”技能在^871F78等级10^000000时达到精通。技能等级越高，你在NPC商店购买物品时支付的费用就越少。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright! Now, in order to become closer towards becoming a true Merchant, I want you to learn the Discount skill up to Level 4.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
好的！现在，为了让你更接近成为一名真正的商人，我希望你将“低价买进”技能提升到4级。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Oooh, good work.
I see that you've
raised your Discount
to Level 4 already.
Here, take this
small reward~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
哦，干得好。
我看到你已经将“低价买进”提升到4级了。
拿着，这是给你的小奖励~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Incredible!
You've actually mastered the Discount skill! You're such a great student. You deserve a bit of a reward!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
难以置信！
你真的精通了“低价买进”技能！你真是个好学生。你值得获得一点奖励！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
It'd be nicer if you could
master it, but you might be more interested in devoting your time to other skills.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
如果你能精通它当然更好，但你可能更想把时间花在研究其他技能上。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Still, you can't ignore the fact that bargaining is an essential skill for a Merchant! Come back to me when you're ready~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
不过，你不能忽视这样一个事实：讨价还价是商人必备的技能！准备好后再来找我~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Not yet, huh?
Well, you should be able to reach that goal soon. After all, it's one of the basics of being a Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
还没准备好吗？
嗯，你应该很快就能达到那个目标。毕竟，这是成为商人的基本功之一！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, you've learned
how to use the Discount skill
well enough. Good, here's a little reward for your hard work~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
啊，看来你已经足够熟练地使用“低价买进”技能了。很好，这是对你辛勤工作的一点小奖励~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Incredible!
You've actually mastered the Discount skill! You're such a great student. You deserve a bit of a reward!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
难以置信！
你真的精通了“低价买进”技能！你真是个好学生。你值得获得一点奖励！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright, my next lesson will hopefully offer you a bit more of a challenge. Come back when you think you're ready, alright?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
好的，我的下一课希望能给你一点挑战。等你觉得自己准备好了再来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
^871F78Mammonite^000000 is a skill that lets you greatly damage targets with Zeny. Money really is power!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
^871F78金钱攻击^000000是一个可以用Zeny对目标造成巨大伤害的技能。金钱真的是力量！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
The upside is that it inflicts great damage and only uses a little SP. However, the downside is that it will also consume your Zeny!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
它的优点是造成巨大伤害且只消耗少量SP。然而，缺点是它也会消耗你的Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So if you use this skill too often, you might end up bankrupt! So be really careful. Also, as the Skill Level for Mammonite increases, so does the attack strength and Zeny consumption.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
所以如果你太频繁地使用这个技能，你可能会破产！所以要非常小心。另外，随着“金钱攻击”技能等级的提高，攻击强度和Zeny消耗也会增加。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, I see that you've already tried this skill. How much money have you wasted using Mammonite? Not too much, I hope.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
啊，我看到你已经尝试过这个技能了。你在使用“金钱攻击”时浪费了多少钱？希望不是太多。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Okay. Now I think we're ready for me to discuss the ^871F78Discount^000000 skill. Come back when you'd like me to tell you more about it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
好的。现在我觉得我们可以讨论^871F78低价买进^000000技能了。等你想听我详细介绍时再来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Well, since you're still green, I feel awfully sorry if you've wasted Zeny. Why don't you take this as compensation?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
嗯，既然你还是新手，如果你浪费了Zeny，我会感到很抱歉的。不如收下这个作为补偿吧？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Okay. Now I think we're ready for me to discuss the ^871F78Discount^000000 skill. Come back when you'd like me to tell you more about it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
好的。现在我觉得我们可以讨论^871F78低价买进^000000技能了。等你想听我详细介绍时再来找我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah. I can tell that you have. Not bad! By now you should be able to learn the ^871F78Discount^000000 skill, but I'll teach you about that later.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
啊。看得出来你已经掌握了。不错！到现在你应该能学习^871F78低价买进^000000技能了，不过我会稍后再教你。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
No? That's fine.
But I can't teach you
much more if you can't grasp these simple basics, so hurry and learn those skills, okay?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
没有？没关系。
但如果你连这些基础都掌握不了，我就很难教你更多了，所以快点学会那些技能，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
There are a few other basic skills which you can learn right away that I'll talk about first. Let's not rush~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
还有几个你可以立刻学习的基本技能，我先讲讲这些。别着急~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
First, there's the ^871F78Item Appraisal^000000 skill. This ability, once you've learned it, allows you to ^871F78identify unknown items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
首先，是^871F78物品鉴定^000000技能。学会这个能力后，你就可以^871F78鉴定未知物品^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
This skill works exactly like a ^871F78Magnifier^000000, so you won't have to spend any Zeny on them. Also, this skill is mastered at ^871F78Level 1^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
这个技能的作用和^871F78放大镜^000000完全一样，所以你不需要再花钱买放大镜了。而且，这个技能在^871F781级^000000时就已经精通了。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
I see in your eyes that you've already learned to appraise items. Haha, although having that knowledge is reward in itself, let me give you something extra!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
从你的眼神里我看得出，你已经学会鉴定物品了。哈哈，虽然掌握这项知识本身就是一种奖励，但我还是再给你点额外的东西吧！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright, next time
I'll talk about the Mammonite skill. For now, let me take a little bit of a break from all of this arduous lecture. ^666666*Whew!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
好了，下次我会讲“金钱攻击”技能。现在让我从这枯燥的讲课中休息一下。^666666*呼！*^000000

scripts.text:
Alright, next time
I'll talk about the Mammonite skill. For now, let me take a little bit of a break from all of this arduous lecture. ^666666*Whew!*^000000
scripts.translation: 好了，下次我会讲“金钱攻击”技能。现在让我从这枯燥的讲课中休息一下。^666666*呼！*^000000

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: I'll make it on my own!
scripts.translation: 我自己来！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
{0}
But first things first!
You better learn the
^871F78Increase Weight Limit^000000 skill!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
{0}
不过，凡事要从头来！
你最好先学会^871F78负重量上升^000000技能！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
You can't really be a Merchant if you can't even carry around goods to sell. As you increase the level of this skill, you can carry around more items.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
如果你连用来出售的商品都带不了，怎么能算是商人呢。随着这个技能等级的提高，你可以携带更多的物品。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Why don't you upgrade your
Increase Weight Limit skill up to Level 4? After that, we can talk more about becoming a true Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
不如你把“负重量上升”技能升到4级？之后，我们可以再谈谈如何成为一名真正的商人。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Great...!
Ah, and I see that you've learned the ^871F78Increase Weight Limit^000000 skill to at least Level 4. You're a real go-getter, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
很好...！
啊，我看到你已经把^871F78负重量上升^000000技能学到了至少4级。你真是个行动派，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Since your Increase Weight
Limit skill level is high enough, you must be able to see a new skill in your Skill Window: ^871F78Discount^000000!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
既然你的“负重量上升”技能等级足够高，你应该能在技能窗口看到一个新技能：^871F78低价买进^000000！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
But we'll discuss the Discount skill later. There are a few other basic skills which you can learn right away that I'll talk about first. Let's not rush~
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
但我们稍后再讨论“低价买进”技能。还有几个你可以立刻学习的基本技能，我先讲讲这些。别着急~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
First, there's the ^871F78Item Appraisal^000000 skill. This ability, once you've learned it, allows you to ^871F78identify unknown items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
首先，是^871F78物品鉴定^000000技能。学会这个能力后，你就可以^871F78鉴定未知物品^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
This skill works exactly like a ^871F78Magnifier^000000, so you won't have to spend any Zeny on them. Also, this skill is mastered at ^871F78Level 1^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
这个技能的作用和^871F78放大镜^000000完全一样，所以你不需要再花钱买放大镜了。而且，这个技能在^871F781级^000000时就已经精通了。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
I see in your eyes that you've already learned to appraise items. Haha, although having that knowledge is reward in itself, let me give you something extra!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
从你的眼神里我看得出，你已经学会鉴定物品了。哈哈，虽然掌握这项知识本身就是一种奖励，但我还是再给你点额外的东西吧！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright, next time
I'll talk about the Mammonite skill. For now, let me take a little bit of a break from all of this arduous study.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
好了，下次我会讲“金钱攻击”技能。现在让我从这枯燥的学习中休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright, next time
I'll talk about the Mammonite skill. For now, let me take a little bit of a break from all of this arduous lecture. ^666666*Whew!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
好了，下次我会讲“金钱攻击”技能。现在让我从这枯燥的讲课中休息一下。^666666*呼！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Oh...
And I'll tell you
more about the Discount
skill later. I always manage
to forget about that!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
哦...
我会稍后再告诉你更多关于“低价买进”技能的事。我总是会忘记那件事！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
On your own?
Hahaha, that's the spirit!
But still, the advice I'm giving is free. It couldn't hurt to give what I say a little bit of thought.
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
靠你自己？
哈哈，有这股劲头就好！
不过，我给出的建议是免费的。稍微听听也无妨。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Well, if you ever change your mind, stop by and talk to me anytime. And as a Merchant, you should know that free advice is the best!
scripts.translation:
[瓜尔涅恩]
如果你改变主意了，随时来找我聊聊。而且作为商人，你应该知道，免费的建议才是最棒的！

scripts.text: [Sagle]
scripts.translation: [萨格尔]

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
It's on the tip
of my tongue, but
I can't quite remember...
scripts.translation:
[萨格尔]
就在嘴边，但我就是想不起来...

scripts.text:
It's on the tip
of my tongue, but
I can't quite remember...
scripts.translation: 就在嘴边，但我就是想不起来...

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
You know, the name of the company that has all those beautiful ladies working for it. Ka... Ka-something. Anyway, I hear they're concerned about their growing competition.
scripts.translation:
[萨格尔]
你知道的，就是那家有很多漂亮女士工作的公司。卡...卡什么的。总之，我听说他们很担心日益激烈的竞争。

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
It's none of my business, but it's good to know what's going on in
the world, particularly if it'll affect the markets.
scripts.translation:
[萨格尔]
这不是我的事，但了解世界上的动态总是好的，特别是如果它会影响到市场的话。

scripts.text:
Hello, hello~
Why don't you buy
some Red Potions?
They're essential for travel, and these Red Potions are the best for newer adventurers~
scripts.translation:
你好，你好~
要不要买些红色药水？
它们是旅行必备品，而且这些红色药水最适合新手冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
I will sell you 10 Red Potions for ^871F78{0} zeny^000000. You'd better get them now while they're still here!
scripts.translation:
[萨格尔]
我要以^871F78{0} Zeny^000000的价格卖给你10瓶红色药水。趁它们还在的时候赶紧买吧！

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 购买

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
Excellent!
You certainly have an eye for bargains. Here you go, 10 Red Potions fresh from the... Potioner...
scripts.translation:
[萨格尔]
太棒了！
你确实很有眼光。给你，10瓶新鲜的...来自...药剂师的...红色药水。

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
Whoa, hold on!
You can't afford
these potions...
Please come back
when you have enough
Zeny, alright?
scripts.translation:
[萨格尔]
哇，等一下！
你买不起这些药水...
等你有足够的Zeny再回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
Whoa, hold on!
There's no way you carry all of this! Why don't you put some of your stuff in Kafra Storage before coming back?
scripts.translation:
[萨格尔]
哇，等一下！
你不可能携带这么多东西！为什么不在回来之前把一些东西放进卡普拉仓库呢？

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
Alright...
But don't
complain if
these potions
are sold out!
scripts.translation:
[萨格尔]
好吧...
但如果这些药水卖光了，可别抱怨哦！

scripts.text: [Kellion]
scripts.translation: [凯利恩]

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
Recently, I hear that something
has happened to the royal family.
scripts.translation:
[凯利恩]
最近，我听说王室发生了一些事情。

scripts.text:
Recently, I hear that something
has happened to the royal family.
scripts.translation: 最近，我听说王室发生了一些事情。

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
It's probably not even a reliable rumor, but I've heard that members of the royal family have been dying from some unknown cause.
scripts.translation:
[凯利恩]
这可能只是不可靠的谣言，但我听说王室成员因某种未知原因相继去世。

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
Huh.
Now that's some morbid news!
Well, hopefully, there's no truth to it whatsoever. None at all...
scripts.translation:
[凯利恩]
哈。
这真是令人毛骨悚然的新闻！
希望这完全不是真的。一点都不...

scripts.text:
I'm selling sets of
10 Red Potions for {0} Zeny.
Would you like some?
scripts.translation:
我正在以{0} Zeny的价格出售10瓶装的红色药水。
你要买一些吗？

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 购买

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
Good choice~
Thank you for
using my shop.
scripts.translation:
[凯利恩]
好选择~
感谢光临我的店铺。

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
Ooops!
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough Zeny. I've got to stay in business somehow, you know?
scripts.translation:
[凯利恩]
哎呀！
抱歉，你的Zeny不够。我也得想办法维持生意，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
...Huh?
You better put some of your stuff in Kafra Storage, you can't carry much else!
scripts.translation:
[凯利恩]
...咦？
你最好把一些东西存进卡普拉仓库，你没法再携带更多东西了！

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
Well, I'm sorry
to hear that. But
I guess I'll see
you later.
scripts.translation:
[凯利恩]
听到这个我很难过。
不过我想我们下次再见吧。

scripts.text: [Aigie]
scripts.translation: [艾吉]

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
It's true that money isn't everything. I'm sure other things are important to have in order to be happy.
scripts.translation:
[艾吉]
确实，金钱不是万能的。我相信还有其他东西对于幸福来说也很重要。

scripts.text: It's true that money isn't everything. I'm sure other things are important to have in order to be happy.
scripts.translation: 确实，金钱不是万能的。我相信还有其他东西对于幸福来说也很重要。

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
However, money can be much more dependable than some people I know. You can rely on money more than anything else in this world.
scripts.translation:
[艾吉]
然而，金钱比我认识的一些人更可靠。在这个世界上，你可以比依赖任何东西都更依赖金钱。

scripts.text:
Welcome to my shop.
I'm just a young girl who's a victim of circumstance, forced to sell potions on the street for dirt cheap prices.
scripts.translation:
欢迎光临我的小店。
我只是一个身不由己的年轻女孩，被迫在街头以极低的价格出售药水。

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
Would you like
to buy 10 Red Potions
for {0} Zeny, kind adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[艾吉]
亲爱的冒险者，您愿意以{0} Zeny的价格购买10瓶红色药水吗？

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 购买

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
Thank you so much.
Now I can finally
afford food again...
scripts.translation:
[艾吉]
非常感谢。
现在我终于能买得起食物了...

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
Wait, wait!
I am sorry, but you don't have enough money. Would you please get some more Zeny before coming back?
scripts.translation:
[艾吉]
等等，等等！
抱歉，您的钱不够。请您多准备一些Zeny再来好吗？

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
Wait, wait!
You can't possibly carry any more items. Why don't you put your things in Kafra Storage first?
scripts.translation:
[艾吉]
等等，等等！
您不可能携带更多物品了。为什么不先把您的东西存进卡普拉仓库呢？

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
I understand.
But I hope you
see that I'm offering
you a really good price.
^666666*Sniff Sniff*^000000
scripts.translation:
[艾吉]
我理解。
但我希望您能明白，我给您的是非常优惠的价格。
^666666*吸鼻子*^000000

scripts.text: [Jayon]
scripts.translation: [杰永]

scripts.text:
[Jayon]
The Schwarzwald Republic...
It's a really interesting country. There's Juno and a few other places worth looking around.
scripts.translation:
[杰永]
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国...
这是一个非常有趣的国家。那里有朱诺和其他几个值得探索的地方。

scripts.text:
The Schwarzwald Republic...
It's a really interesting country. There's Juno and a few other places worth looking around.
scripts.translation:
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国...
这是一个非常有趣的国家。那里有朱诺和其他几个值得探索的地方。

scripts.text:
[Jayon]
They may not be the best places
for sight seeing, but I'm sure they'll offer something of interest to you adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[杰永]
它们可能不是最好的观光地点，但我相信它们会给你们冒险者带来一些有趣的体验。

scripts.text: If you've checked out the market for Red Potions, you know that my price is the best. I'm offering 10 Red Potions for only {0} Zeny!
scripts.translation: 如果您已经去市场上看过红色药水的价格，您就会知道我的价格是最优的。我只需{0} Zeny就能卖给您10瓶红色药水！

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 购买

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Jayon]
Heh heh...!
It looks like
you know your
stuff. You're a
Merchant yourself,
aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[杰永]
嘿嘿...
看来您很懂行。
您自己也是个商人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Jayon]
But sorry buddy.
Rules are rules.
You gotta meet my price
if you want these potions.
scripts.translation:
[杰永]
但是抱歉，伙计。
规矩就是规矩。
如果您想要这些药水，就必须接受我的价格。

scripts.text:
[Jayon]
But sorry buddy. I can't let you carry more than you can handle.
You ought to free up some of your inventory space when you get the chance.
scripts.translation:
[杰永]
但是抱歉，伙计。我不能让您携带超过您能处理的数量。
您应该找机会清理一下您的物品栏空间。

scripts.text:
[Jayon]
Just looking
around, eh?
I understand.
But you better take
advantage of a real
deal when you see one!
scripts.translation:
[杰永]
只是随便看看，是吗？
我理解。
但如果您看到真正的优惠，可千万别错过！

scripts.text: [Maos]
scripts.translation: [马奥斯]

scripts.text:
[Maos]
I see too many people struggling to scrape every penny and put it all into their savings...
scripts.translation:
[马奥斯]
我看到太多人为了攒每一分钱而苦苦挣扎，把它们全部存起来...

scripts.text: I see too many people struggling to scrape every penny and put it all into their savings...
scripts.translation: 我看到太多人为了攒每一分钱而苦苦挣扎，把它们全部存起来...

scripts.text:
[Maos]
Now, don't get me wrong. It's a good idea to invest in the future. But money exists to be spent! Enjoy every moment, that's what I say~
scripts.translation:
[马奥斯]
别误会。为未来投资是个好主意。但钱就是用来花的！尽情享乐，这就是我的信条~

scripts.text:
[Maos]
Besides...
You can't take
your money with you
when your time's up,
you know?
scripts.translation:
[马奥斯]
而且...
人死的时候，钱是带不走的，您知道的吧？

scripts.text:
Don't say anything.
I know what you want.
10 Red Potions, right?
I'll sell them to you
for the low price of {0} Zeny~
scripts.translation:
别说话。
我知道您想要什么。
10瓶红色药水，对吧？
我以{0} Zeny的低价卖给您~

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 购买

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Maos]
Excellent choice!
Good products at affordable prices! That's my ethic as a merchant.
scripts.translation:
[马奥斯]
眼光不错！
物美价廉！这就是我作为商人的信条。

scripts.text:
[Maos]
Ooh, but you don't even have enough Zeny to purchase these potions. I'm sorry, but I can't sell these just to lose money, you know?
scripts.translation:
[马奥斯]
哎呀，但您连买这些药水的Zeny都不够。很抱歉，但我不能亏本卖给您，您知道的吧？

scripts.text:
[Maos]
Ooh, but it doesn't look like you've got enough inventory space to carry any more items.
scripts.translation:
[马奥斯]
哎呀，看起来您的物品栏空间也不够再装下更多物品了。

scripts.text:
[Maos]
Well, I can't force you to buy these, but I'm telling you that you're passing up a real bargain!
scripts.translation:
[马奥斯]
好吧，我不能强迫您买这些，但我告诉您，您正在错过一个真正的便宜货！
